description: This Dart source file defines the NotificationsProvider class, which manages notifications and their read/unread state within a Flutter application. It provides methods for loading notifications, adding new notifications, marking notifications as read, and clearing notifications. It also handles initial seeding of a welcome notification.

classes.name: NotificationsProvider
classes.description: A provider class managing notifications, their loading state, and read/unread status in a Flutter application.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the NotificationsProvider, loading data and seeding a welcome notification if necessary.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads notifications from the repository and updates the loading state.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new notification to the repository and reloads the notifications list.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a notification as read by its ID and reloads the notifications list.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all notifications from the repository and reloads the list.
